scope: Bounded, score-neutral relevant-experience explanation from approved career facts; MJ-REQ-114 remains PARTIAL.
user_visible_behavior: Job Detail shows a Relevant experience fit factor when a profile and match are selected.

ALIGNS is limited to locally recognized job skills found in verified, user-approved, sourced experience, responsibility, project, accomplishment, or technology-experience facts with confidence of at least 80.
Unsupported or missing evidence remains UNKNOWN. A known but nonoverlapping comparison says other experience may not be represented; it does not claim the person lacks a qualification.
The factor is informational and has no effect on the numeric match score.

verification.browser: Connected isolated SQLite/API/Chromium; external requests were blocked and none were observed. Job Detail read back the match, displayed approved experience evidence, excluded pending experience text, and retained the 0% score.

web_bundle.note: The frontend was unchanged by this slice; the existing current-main build was used to verify its generic fit-factor renderer.

additional_checks: Python compilation of the service and new tests: PASS.

known_unrelated_failure.cause: The test's exact Job title label locator resolves to both the capture field and the Jobs search filter. Reproduced on main; not changed in this feature.

not_run: Hosted Actions and hosted review, disabled by policy
Real application submission, which remains OFF
limitations: The factor compares recognized job skills to approved experience facts; it does not assess time-in-role, seniority, depth, or qualification.
Overall MJ-REQ-114 and parent MJ-PR-031 remain PARTIAL; dependencies and acceptance statuses are unchanged.
